project_title: Satellite Thermal Anomaly Classification in India (VIIRS NOAA-20 2025)

frozen_primary_dataset.role: Primary deployment testbed, causal history, Deep SAD unlabeled pool, and stationary confounder calibration

shortlisted_datasets.dataset_name: FIRMS VIIRS NOAA-20 SP India 2025 (Causal Feature Table)
shortlisted_datasets.provider_authority: NASA LANCE / FIRMS & Project Causal Feature Pipeline
shortlisted_datasets.license: NASA Open Data Policy / Project Internal Frozen Baseline
shortlisted_datasets.native_label: Unlabeled satellite active fire detections + 15 verified acute events + 1,870 persistent confounders
shortlisted_datasets.our_label: Unlabeled Pool (y_SAD = -1 / Unknown), Positive Anomaly Anchors (y = -1 in SAD; y in {1, 2, 3} in classifier), Persistent Confounders (is_supervised_target = False)
shortlisted_datasets.target_model_branch: Deep SAD (Semi-Supervised Anomaly Core), Causal Sequence Pipeline, Multimodal Fusion
shortlisted_datasets.target_task: Unlabeled manifold representation learning, stationary confounder calibration, positive supervision anchors, and in-domain deployment testbed
shortlisted_datasets.exact_features_or_labels_provided: 51 causal thermal/spatial features (FRP, I4/I5 brightness temps, 6h/24h causal cluster counts, local density, scan/track); 1,870 stationary confounder flags (Class 4); 15 certified acute anomaly anchors (2 Ind, 5 Forest, 8 Agri); 1,173,910 unlabeled rows (y_SAD = -1 / Unknown).
shortlisted_datasets.why_needed: Serves as the empirical foundation of the entire research project; represents the exact operational data distribution and real-world deployment target in India.
shortlisted_datasets.what_it_cannot_provide: It cannot provide independent ground truth labels for the 1.17M unlabeled detections; it cannot provide sub-pixel optical imagery or parcel boundary scars.

shortlisted_datasets.dataset_name: Derived FIRMS Event Sequences (NIFC/MTBS Fire Perimeters + VIIRS 375m Archive)
shortlisted_datasets.provider_authority: National Interagency Fire Center (NIFC) / USGS MTBS / NASA FIRMS Archive (Constructed by Project Pipeline)
shortlisted_datasets.methodological_precedent: 2026 FIRMS active fire sequence modeling and USDA/USFS MTBS multi-timestep wildfire progression mapping
shortlisted_datasets.construction_formula: Official VIIRS active-fire observations + NIFC/MTBS fire-perimeter records + spatiotemporal matching + FIRMS-like feature extraction + event sequence construction

raw_source_datasets.name: USGS MTBS / NIFC Interagency Fire Perimeter History
NASA VIIRS 375m Active Fire Point Archive (VNP14IMGTDL / VJ114IMGTDL)

shortlisted_datasets.access_protocol: Constructed locally via spatial-temporal joining pipeline
shortlisted_datasets.license: US Public Domain / Creative Commons CC0
shortlisted_datasets.data_format: Apache Parquet 3D Tensor Structure [Batch, Timesteps (T=16), Channels (C=8)]
shortlisted_datasets.native_label: Official Wildfire Incident Perimeter and Burn Severity Boundary
shortlisted_datasets.target_task: Self-supervised masked autoencoding and pretraining of 1D TCN on physical combustion growth, peak FRP, and diurnal cooling trajectories

join_keys.spatial_join: Geodesic Point-in-Polygon (ST_Within) matching VIIRS point to MTBS/NIFC event polygon perimeter

shortlisted_datasets.train_val_test_split_strategy: Strict event-level split by fire_event_id (70% train, 15% val, 15% test) to prevent temporal and spatial leakage
shortlisted_datasets.why_needed: WildfireSpreadTS and TS-SatFire are 2D raster image grids that cannot train a 1D tabular sequence model. This derived dataset provides thousands of multi-day combustion time-series matching our exact causal feature space.
shortlisted_datasets.what_it_cannot_provide: Cannot provide Indian tropical/monsoonal vegetation characteristics; cannot provide chemical explosion kinetics or smallholder agricultural field scars.

shortlisted_datasets.dataset_name: Global Fire Atlas (GFA) 2003-2025 + FSI Forest Canopy Density Mask
shortlisted_datasets.provider_authority: NASA GSFC / UC Irvine (Andela et al.) & Forest Survey of India (FSI)
shortlisted_datasets.access_protocol: Open HTTPS Download via Zenodo / FSI Geoportal
shortlisted_datasets.data_format: ESRI Shapefile / GeoPackage (Vectors) & GeoTIFF (Forest Canopy Mask)
shortlisted_datasets.input_modality: Geospatial Polygon Vectors & Raster Canopy Cover Mask
shortlisted_datasets.native_label: MCD64A1-derived individual fire perimeter and lifecycle attributes (tracks all vegetation fires)
shortlisted_datasets.our_label: Class 2 (Forest Fire) Candidate ONLY IF passing Forest Canopy Gate (Canopy Cover >= 10% or Reserved Forest); otherwise Cropland candidate or Ambiguous/Excluded
shortlisted_datasets.target_model_branch: Forest Fire Branch & Supervised Ground-Truth Matching Pipeline
shortlisted_datasets.target_task: Providing independent polygon perimeters, ignition dates, extinction dates, spread rates, and durations for large forest fires across India
shortlisted_datasets.exact_features_or_labels_provided: fire_id, ig_date (ignition date), cl_date (extinction date), dur (duration in days), tot_ar (burned area km2), speed (km/day), direction, polygon geometry. FSI Mask provides forest canopy density class (VDF, MDF, OF, Non-Forest).
shortlisted_datasets.why_needed: Provides objective, independent satellite-derived fire perimeters and lifecycle boundaries for wildland combustion events in India, eliminating reliance on raw FIRMS clustering.
shortlisted_datasets.what_it_cannot_provide: GFA events are NOT automatically Forest Fire. It cannot be used without the Forest Canopy Gate (because GFA tracks all global vegetation fires, including savannas and crop residue); cannot delineate sub-500m fires due to MODIS sensor resolution.

shortlisted_datasets.dataset_name: Sentinel-2 L2A STAC Collection + ICAR-IARI CREAMS Crop Residue Bulletins
shortlisted_datasets.provider_authority: European Space Agency (Copernicus) & ICAR-IARI Satellite Agricultural Monitoring
shortlisted_datasets.access_protocol: Spatially Targeted STAC API (Planetary Computer / AWS Open Data) + IARI Daily Bulletins
shortlisted_datasets.license: Copernicus Open Access / ICAR Open Research Data
shortlisted_datasets.input_modality: Decametric Optical Multispectral Bands (10m/20m) & Geospatial CSV Records
shortlisted_datasets.native_label: Pre/Post Surface Reflectance (B04, B08, B11, B12) & Daily Stubble Active Fire Coordinates
shortlisted_datasets.our_label: Class 3 (Agricultural Fire) confirmed strictly via 4-part composite rule with configurable calibration parameters
shortlisted_datasets.target_model_branch: Agricultural Fire Branch & Composite Ground-Truth Matcher
shortlisted_datasets.target_task: Multi-condition verification of agricultural stubble burning via parcel-level optical burn scars and daily agricultural monitoring bulletins
shortlisted_datasets.exact_features_or_labels_provided: Pre-burn and post-burn surface reflectance (B04, B08, B11, B12), differenced Normalized Burn Ratio (dNBR), post-burn NIR drop ratio, parcel coordinates, district-level daily stubble fire counts and coordinates.
shortlisted_datasets.why_needed: Optical burn scars at 10m/20m resolution prove physical combustion on agricultural parcels, transforming ambiguous thermal points into certified Class 3 ground truth.
shortlisted_datasets.what_it_cannot_provide: Cannot provide cloud-penetrating evidence during continuous overcast conditions; dNBR alone without crop mask and harvest window cannot distinguish stubble fires from plowed dry soil.

shortlisted_datasets.dataset_name: Ma et al. 2019 India Industrial Heat Sources + SEBI Reg 30 Incident Filings
shortlisted_datasets.provider_authority: ISPRS / Chinese Academy of Sciences (Ma et al.) & Securities and Exchange Board of India
shortlisted_datasets.access_protocol: Open Journal Supplementary Repository / BSE & NSE Statutory Corporate Filings
shortlisted_datasets.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC-BY-4.0) / Public Regulatory Disclosures
shortlisted_datasets.data_format: GeoJSON Point Vectors & Structured JSON Corporate Filings
shortlisted_datasets.input_modality: Geospatial Point Vectors (Industrial Facilities) & Text/JSON Regulatory Filings
shortlisted_datasets.native_label: Heavy Industrial Heat Source Entity (ISPRS) & Material Disaster Announcements (SEBI Reg 30)
shortlisted_datasets.our_label: Class 4 Confounder (PERSISTENT_THERMAL_SOURCE, is_supervised_target = False) & Class 1 Positive Anchors (INDUSTRIAL_FIRE)
shortlisted_datasets.target_model_branch: Confounder Suppression Branch (Class 4) & Industrial Fire Few-Shot Calibration (Class 1)
shortlisted_datasets.target_task: Isolating stationary industrial thermal emitters from acute emergency disasters, and providing statutory incident anchors for industrial fire classification
shortlisted_datasets.exact_features_or_labels_provided: Geocoded coordinates of heavy industrial heat source complexes (iron & steel plants, cement kilns, chemical refineries, thermal power plants); statutory corporate fire emergency disclosures with date, hour, facility name, loss valuation, and incident narrative.
shortlisted_datasets.why_needed: Solves the spatial proximity fallacy by explicitly distinguishing normal operational industrial emitters (confounders) from certified emergency industrial disaster fires.
shortlisted_datasets.what_it_cannot_provide: Cannot detect small informal industrial fires (e.g. unlisted scrap warehouses or informal textile units lacking statutory corporate disclosure); cannot provide automated daily incident alerts.

shortlisted_datasets.dataset_name: DIOR Benchmark: Optical Remote Sensing Object Detection (Tanks & Chimneys)
shortlisted_datasets.provider_authority: Northwestern Polytechnical University (Li et al., ISPRS P&RS 2020)
shortlisted_datasets.access_protocol: Direct Academic Download via NWPU / Academic Mirror
shortlisted_datasets.data_format: JPEG Satellite Chips (800x800) + XML / YOLO Bounding Boxes
shortlisted_datasets.native_label: Bounding boxes for Storage Tank and Chimney
shortlisted_datasets.our_label: Industrial Asset Presence Probability P(Industrial Asset) and Structural Bounding Boxes
shortlisted_datasets.target_task: Pretraining YOLOv8n-Infra to identify industrial manufacturing infrastructure (storage tanks and industrial chimneys/exhaust stacks) in high-resolution optical satellite chips
shortlisted_datasets.exact_features_or_labels_provided: 10,500+ annotated bounding boxes for Storage Tank; 3,800+ annotated bounding boxes for Chimney; normalized box coordinates [class, x_center, y_center, width, height].
shortlisted_datasets.why_needed: Gives YOLOv8n spatial perception to detect petrochemical storage tanks and factory flues, enabling the multimodal fusion head to determine whether a thermal anomaly is colocated with industrial assets.
shortlisted_datasets.what_it_cannot_provide: Cannot detect active combustion, smoke, or fire; cannot directly label an industrial fire event without independent incident confirmation; imagery consists primarily of US/Chinese facilities requiring Indian domain adaptation.

shortlisted_datasets.dataset_name: FASDD_RS: Flame and Smoke Detection Dataset (Remote Sensing Split)
shortlisted_datasets.provider_authority: Wuhan University (Yue et al., Int. J. Digital Earth 2023)
shortlisted_datasets.access_protocol: Open Access Download via Science Data Bank
shortlisted_datasets.data_format: Optical Satellite Images (10m-30m) + Native YOLO Format Text Annotations
shortlisted_datasets.native_label: Native YOLO format bounding boxes for Flame and Smoke
shortlisted_datasets.our_label: Combustion Plume Presence Probability P(Smoke Plume), P(Flame Front)
shortlisted_datasets.target_task: Pretraining YOLOv8n-Fire/Smoke to detect active combustion flame fronts and dispersing smoke plumes in optical satellite scenes
shortlisted_datasets.exact_features_or_labels_provided: Thousands of bounding boxes for 'Flame' and 'Smoke' in native YOLO text format, normalized bounding coordinates, and confidence metadata.
shortlisted_datasets.why_needed: Provides visual evidence of active uncontained combustion and plume dispersion, complementing FIRMS mid-infrared radiometry with optical plume confirmation.
shortlisted_datasets.what_it_cannot_provide: Cannot distinguish an industrial smoke plume from a forest fire smoke plume on optical texture alone; cannot penetrate cloud decks or detect nighttime fires (optical sensor limitation).

proposed_in_domain_annotation_task.task_name: Targeted Indian Satellite Optical Benchmark Annotation
proposed_in_domain_annotation_task.purpose: Domain adaptation of pretrained YOLOv8n-Infra and YOLOv8n-Fire/Smoke models to irregular Indian industrial shed morphology, smallholder agricultural parcel geometry, and monsoonal atmospheric aerosol conditions.

dataset_rejection_register.exclusion_rationale: Format Incompatibility. WildfireSpreadTS is a 2D multi-modal raster image dataset (64x64 patches of active fire masks, ERA5 weather, fuel rasters, DEM) designed for 2D ConvNets and ConvLSTMs. It cannot be used to pretrain a 1D Temporal Convolutional Network operating on 51-column tabular FIRMS point sequences without artificial rasterization. Replaced by DS_02 (tabular event sequences constructed from MTBS/NIFC perimeters joined with VIIRS active fire archives).

Format Incompatibility. Similar to WildfireSpreadTS, TS-SatFire packages multi-temporal 2D satellite image rasters rather than tabular point sequences. Its spatial convolutional feature extractors do not transfer to our 1D tabular sequence architecture.

dataset_rejection_register.dataset_name: Stanford South Asia Brick Kilns Dataset (PNAS 2020)
dataset_rejection_register.exclusion_rationale: Redundancy & Consolidation. The 50,000+ brick kilns are already represented as persistent thermal sources in our audited Class 4 confounder table (1,870 rows) and in the heavy industrial heat source inventories (DS_05). Preserving project focus and staying strictly within the 7-dataset limit.

dataset_rejection_register.dataset_name: World Bank Global Gas Flaring Tracker (GGFR)
dataset_rejection_register.exclusion_rationale: Redundancy. Stationary gas flare locations across India are already absorbed into the stationary confounder mask and DS_05 heavy industrial heat source catalogs.

dataset_rejection_register.dataset_name: MODIS MCD64A1 Raw Rasters (500m Global HDF)
dataset_rejection_register.exclusion_rationale: Redundancy & High Overhead. The Global Fire Atlas (DS_03) has already processed, clustered, and validated MCD64A1 into discrete fire event polygons with ignition and extinction dates, rendering raw multi-gigabyte HDF raster ingestion unnecessary.

Domain Mismatch. DOTA focuses on generic aerial objects (planes, vehicles, bridges) with sparse industrial targets; FLAME 2 is low-altitude drone video footage, whose sub-centimeter perspective does not transfer to 10m/375m satellite imagery. Outperformed by DIOR (satellite industrial assets) and FASDD_RS (satellite flame/smoke).
